en: Oh
zh: 喔
ja: ああ
local: Oh
ja_pron: Aa
native: Oh

en: Aahhh...
ja: ああ……
local: Aahhh...
ja_pron: Aa...
native: Aahhh...

en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了我們自然界中變化的規律
ja: 2000年以上前、古代中国の学者たちは自然界の変化するパターンを観察しました
local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural
ja_pron: Nisen nen ijō mae, kodai Chūgoku no gakusha-tachi wa shizen-kai no henka suru pataan o kansatsu shimashita
native: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural

en: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
zh: 世界、氣候、季節的更替和天文現象。
ja: 世界、気候、季節の移り変わり、そして天文学を観察しました。
local: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
ja_pron: Sekai, kikō, kisetsu no utsurikawari, soshite tenmongaku o kansatsu shimashita.
native: world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating
zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運動分成24個部分，創造了
ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを測定し、24の部分に分けて作り出しました
local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating
ja_pron: Gakusha-tachi wa taiyō no nenkan no ugoki o sokutei shi, 24 no bubun ni wakete tsukuridashimashita
native: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating

en: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
zh: 二十四節氣，這些節氣被用來管理古代中國的農業。
ja: 二十四節気を作り出し、古代中国の農業を管理するために使われました。
local: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
ja_pron: Nijūshi sekki o tsukuridashi, kodai Chūgoku no nōgyō o kanri suru tame ni tsukaware mashita.
native: the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は数億人の中国人の生活と伝統を導いています。
local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
ja_pron: Kyō ni itaru made, kono hatsumei wa sū oku-nin no Chūgokujin no seikatsu to dentō o michibiite imasu.
native: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

en: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.
zh: 大約在8月23日，第十四個節氣，暑氣結束。
ja: 8月23日頃、第14の節気である「処暑」が訪れます。
local: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.
ja_pron: Hachigatsu nijūsannichi goro, dai jūyon no sekki de aru 'Shosho' ga otozuremasu.
native: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.

en: It means that the summer heat is over.
zh: 這意味著夏天的炎熱結束了。
ja: これは夏の暑さが終わったことを意味します。
local: It means that the summer heat is over.
ja_pron: Kore wa natsu no atsusa ga owatta koto o imi shimasu.
native: It means that the summer heat is over.

en: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks
zh: 這是農田最佳的收穫季節，也是感恩的時刻
ja: これは農地にとって最高の収穫期であり、感謝を捧げる時期でもあります。
local: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks
ja_pron: Kore wa nōchi ni totte saikō no shūkaku-ki de ari, kansha o sasageru jiki demo arimasu.
native: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks

en: of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.
zh: 感謝所獲得的祝福，也是回憶過去的季節。
ja: 受けた恵みに感謝し、蓄えを思い出す季節です。
local: of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.
ja_pron: Uketa megumi ni kansha shi, takuwae o omoidasu kisetsu desu.
native: of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.

en: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.
zh: 無論夏季熱浪是否過去，大自然都轉向秋天。
ja: 夏の熱波が過ぎ去ると、自然は秋へと移り変わります。
local: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.
ja_pron: Natsu no neppa ga sugisaru to, shizen wa aki e to utsurikawarimasu.
native: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.

en: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.
zh: 處暑節氣正式開始，氣溫迅速下降。
ja: 処暑の節気が正式に始まり、気温が急速に下がります。
local: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.
ja_pron: Shosho no sekki ga seishiki ni hajimari, kion ga kyūsoku ni sagarimasu.
native: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.

en: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.
zh: 雲南是中國民族最多元化的地區之一。
ja: 雲南は中国で最も民族的に多様な地域の一つです。
local: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.
ja_pron: Unnan wa Chūgoku de mottomo minzokuteki ni tayō na chiiki no hitotsu desu.
native: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.

en: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.
zh: 大理位於美麗的洱海湖畔，世代居住著彝族少數民族。
ja: 美しい洱海湖のほとりにある大理は、代々彝族の少数民族が住んでいます。
local: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.
ja_pron: Utsukushii Jikai-ko no hotori ni aru Dali wa, daidai Yi-zoku no shōsū minzoku ga sunde imasu.
native: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.

en: They come from here, and most live nearby.
zh: 他們來自這裡，大多數人住在附近。
ja: 彼らはここから来ており、ほとんどが近くに住んでいます。
local: They come from here, and most live nearby.
ja_pron: Karera wa koko kara kite ori, hotondo ga chikaku ni sunde imasu.
native: They come from here, and most live nearby.

en: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.
zh: 對彝族來說，處暑節氣非常重要。
ja: 彝族にとって、処暑の節気は非常に重要です。
local: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.
ja_pron: Yi-zoku ni totte, Shosho no sekki wa hijō ni jūyō desu.
native: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.

en: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.
zh: 因為這標誌著作物已經準備好收割。
ja: それは作物が収穫の準備ができていることを示しています。
local: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.
ja_pron: Sore wa sakumotsu ga shūkaku no junbi ga dekite iru koto o shimeshite imasu.
native: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.

en: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.
zh: 其中一種植物是彝族最珍惜的，當它成熟時，人們準備慶祝。
ja: そして、何よりも彝族が大切にしている植物があり、それが熟すと人々は祝う準備をします。
local: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.
ja_pron: Soshite, nani yori mo Yi-zoku ga taisetsu ni shite iru shokubutsu ga ari, sore ga jukusu to hitobito wa iwau junbi o shimasu.
native: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.

en: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn,
zh: 當中國大部分地區從夏天的濃綠轉為秋天的金黃時，
ja: 中国の大部分が夏の濃い緑から秋の黄金色に変わる中、
local: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn,
ja_pron: Chūgoku no daibubun ga natsu no koi midori kara aki no ōgon iro ni kawaru naka,
native: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn,

en: here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.
zh: 這裡的靛藍植物已經成熟，人們走出來迎接那片藍色的田野。
ja: ここでは藍の植物が成熟し、人々はその青い畑を迎えに出てきます。
local: here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.
ja_pron: Koko de wa ai no shokubutsu ga seijuku shi, hitobito wa sono aoi hatake o mukae ni dete kimasu.
native: here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.

en: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dines from seasonal flowers and fruits.
zh: 到了新石器時代，中國人已經發現如何從季節性花卉和水果中提取染料。
ja: 新石器時代までに、中国人は季節の花や果物から染料を抽出する方法を発見していました。
local: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dines from seasonal flowers and fruits.
ja_pron: Shinsekki jidai made ni, Chūgokujin wa kisetsu no hana ya kudamono kara senryō o chūshutsu suru hōhō o hakken shite imashita.
native: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dines from seasonal flowers and fruits.

en: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.
zh: 彝族選擇的顏色是處暑節氣的藍色。
ja: 彝族が選んだ色は処暑の節気の青色です。
local: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.
ja_pron: Yi-zoku ga eranda iro wa Shosho no sekki no aoiro desu.
native: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.

en: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.
zh: 段樹泉是彝族海岱的守護者之一。
ja: 段樹泉は彝族海岱の守護者の一人です。
local: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.
ja_pron: Duan Shuquan wa Yi-zoku Haidai no shugosha no hitori desu.
native: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.

en: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine
zh: 靛藍植物在傳統中醫中被認為
ja: 藍の植物は伝統的な中国医学で知られています
local: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine
ja_pron: Ai no shokubutsu wa dentōteki na Chūgoku igaku de shirarete imasu
native: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine

en: for being good for preventing calls.
zh: 對預防感冒有益。
ja: 風邪の予防に良いとされています。
local: for being good for preventing calls.
ja_pron: Kaze no yobō ni yoi to sarete imasu.
native: for being good for preventing calls.

en: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would die in cloth with it.
zh: 但一千多年前，彝族用它來染布。
ja: しかし千年以上前、彝族はそれを使って布を染めていました。
local: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would die in cloth with it.
ja_pron: Shikashi sen nen ijō mae, Yi-zoku wa sore o tsukatte nuno o sometemashita.
native: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would die in cloth with it.

en: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.
zh: 他們發明了扎染藝術，並世代相傳。
ja: 彼らは藍染めの技術を発明し、世代を超えて受け継いできました。
local: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.
ja_pron: Karera wa aizome no gijutsu o hatsumei shi, sedai o koete uketsuide kimashita.
native: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.

en: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.
zh: 這是我今天一開始在捷克井使用的另一件作品。
ja: これは今日の始めにチェコの井戸で使った別の作品です。
local: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.
ja_pron: Kore wa kyō no hajime ni Cheko no ido de tsukatta betsu no sakuhin desu.
native: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.

en: This is oneANAT.
zh: 這是一個ANAT。
ja: これは一つのANATです。
local: This is oneANAT.
ja_pron: Kore wa hitotsu no ANAT desu.
native: This is oneANAT.

en: This is the name of the G.
zh: 這是G的名字。
ja: これはGの名前です。
local: This is the name of the G.
ja_pron: Kore wa G no namae desu.
native: This is the name of the G.

en: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.
zh: 中國的風格不同，通常大氣且充滿活力。
ja: 中国のスタイルは異なり、通常は大きくて良いエネルギーを持っています。
local: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.
ja_pron: Chūgoku no sutairu wa kotonari, tsūjō wa ōkikute yoi enerugī o motte imasu.
native: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.

en: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.
zh: 因此，靛藍扎染的藍色和白色代表純潔、開放和正確。
ja: だから藍染めの青と白は純粋さ、開放性、そして正しさを表しています。
local: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.
ja_pron: Dakara aizome no ao to shiro wa junsui-sa, kaihō-sei, soshite tadashisa o arawashite imasu.
native: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.

en: This is how the buy look at colors.
zh: 這就是彝族看待顏色的方式。
ja: これが彝族の色の見方です。
local: This is how the buy look at colors.
ja_pron: Kore ga Yi-zoku no iro no mikata desu.
native: This is how the buy look at colors.

en: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.
zh: 2015年，一個鞋點將一家全扎染工廠改建成中國第一個專門展示彝族扎染的博物館。
ja: 2015年、ある靴の店が全ての藍染工場を中国で初めて彝族藍染に特化した博物館に改装しました。
local: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.
ja_pron: 2015-nen, aru kutsu no mise ga subete no aizome kōjō o Chūgoku de hajimete Yi-zoku aizome ni tokka shita hakubutsukan ni kaisō shimashita.
native: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.

en: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.
zh: 彝族扎染呈現出如此美麗的藍色，這都歸功於靛藍。
ja: 彝族の藍染はとても美しい青色で、これは藍のおかげです。
local: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.
ja_pron: Yi-zoku no aizome wa totemo utsukushii aoiro de, kore wa ai no okage desu.
native: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.

en: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.
zh: 每到處暑節氣，收割並採摘靛藍葉後，成熟的莖葉會被收集在松木容器中，混合水和石灰浸泡。
ja: 処暑の節気のたびに、藍の葉を収穫し摘み取った後、成熟した茎と葉を松の容器に集め、水と石灰を混ぜて浸します。
local: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.
ja_pron: Shosho no sekki no tabi ni, ai no ha o shūkaku shi tsumitotta ato, seijuku shita kuki to ha o matsu no yōki ni atsume, mizu to sekka o maze te hitashimasu.
native: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.

en: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.
zh: 它們慢慢發酵成藍綠色的溶液，留下沉澱物。
ja: それらはゆっくりと発酵して青緑色の溶液になり、沈殿物を残します。
local: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.
ja_pron: Sorera wa yukkuri to hakkō shite aomidori iro no yōeki ni nari, chindenbutsu o nokoshimasu.
native: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.

en: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.
zh: 水分蒸發後，扎染膏就準備好了，藝術之旅開始了。
ja: 水が蒸発した後、藍染めのペーストが準備でき、芸術の旅が始まります。
local: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.
ja_pron: Mizu ga jōhatsu shita ato, aizome no pēsu to ga junbi deki, geijutsu no tabi ga hajimarimasu.
native: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.

en: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.
zh: 以前，圖案是直接畫在布上，但這既耗時又難以複製。
ja: 以前は布に直接絵を描いていましたが、時間がかかり再現が難しかったです。
local: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.
ja_pron: Izen wa nuno ni chokusetsu e o kaite imashita ga, jikan ga kakari saigen ga muzukashikatta desu.
native: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.

en: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.
zh: 為了擴大生產，繪圖鞋點學會了製作模板。
ja: 生産を拡大するために、描画の靴店は型紙の作り方を学びました。
local: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.
ja_pron: Seisan o kakudai suru tame ni, byōga no kutsu ten wa katagami no tsukurikata o manabimashita.
native: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.

en: There it is.
zh: 就是那個。
ja: あれです。
local: There it is.
ja_pron: Are desu.
native: There it is.

en: Beautiful butterfly.
zh: 美麗的蝴蝶。
ja: 美しい蝶です。
local: Beautiful butterfly.
ja_pron: Utsukushii chō desu.
native: Beautiful butterfly.

en: Here it is.
zh: 在這裡。
ja: ここにあります。
local: Here it is.
ja_pron: Koko ni arimasu.
native: Here it is.

en: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.
zh: 靛藍膏通過模板上的孔滲入布料，形成彝族扎染的標記。
ja: 藍染めのペーストは型紙の穴を通り、布に染み込み、彝族藍染の印をつけます。
local: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.
ja_pron: Aizome no pēsu to wa katagami no ana o tōri, nuno ni shimikomi, Yi-zoku aizome no shirushi o tsukemasu.
native: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.

en: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.
zh: 但對於我們所稱的扎染，先綁紮再染色，第二步是手工藝的核心。
ja: しかし、私たちが藍染めと呼ぶものは、まず結んでから染めることで、その第二の工程が手工芸の核心です。
local: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.
ja_pron: Shikashi, watashitachi ga aizome to yobu mono wa, mazu musunde kara someru koto de, sono daini no kōtei ga shukōgei no kakushin desu.
native: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.

en: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.
zh: 綁紮圖案主要由婦女手工完成。
ja: 結び目の模様は主に女性たちによって作られます。
local: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.
ja_pron: Musubime no moyō wa omoni josei-tachi ni yotte tsukuraremasu.
native: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.

en: This is the first tie-dye.
zh: 這是第一次扎染。
ja: これは最初の藍染めです。
local: This is the first tie-dye.
ja_pron: Kore wa saisho no aizome desu.
native: This is the first tie-dye.

en: This is the first tie-dye.
zh: 這是第一次扎染。
ja: これは最初の藍染めです。
local: This is the first tie-dye.
ja_pron: Kore wa saisho no aizome desu.
native: This is the first tie-dye.

zh: 這是第一次扎染。
ja: これは最初の藍染めです。
local: This is the first tie-dye.
ja_pron: Kore wa saisho no aizome desu.
native: This is the first tie-dye.

zh: 這是第一次扎染。
ja: これは最初の藍染めです。
local: This is the first tie-dye.
ja_pron: Kore wa saisho no aizome desu.
native: This is the first tie-dye.

zh: 這是第一次扎染。
ja: これは最初の藍染めです。
local: This is the first tie-dye.
ja_pron: Kore wa saisho no aizome desu.

en: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.
zh: 綁紮圖案是扎染的核心技藝。
ja: 結び目の模様は藍染めの核心技術です。
local: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.
ja_pron: Musubime no moyō wa aizome no kakushin gijutsu desu.
native: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.

en: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.
zh: 決定成品的圖案和顏色是關鍵。
ja: 完成品の模様と色を決めることが重要です。
local: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.
ja_pron: Kanseihin no moyō to iro o kimeru koto ga jūyō desu.
native: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.

en: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.
zh: 之後染色過程是最秘密的步驟。
ja: その後の染色工程は最も秘密にされているステップです。
local: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.
ja_pron: Sonogo no senshoku kōtei wa mottomo himitsu ni sarete iru suteppu desu.
native: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.

en: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.
zh: 根據彝族傳統，染料是按照秘密配方製作，絕不外傳。
ja: 彝族の伝統によれば、染料は秘密のレシピに従って作られ、外部には決して教えられません。
local: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.
ja_pron: Yi-zoku no dentō ni yoreba, senryō wa himitsu no reshipi ni shitagatte tsukurare, gaibu ni wa kesshite oshieraremasen.
native: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.

en: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.
zh: 所以，段先生只答應教我如何使用預先混合的染料溶液染布。
ja: そこで、段さんは事前に混ぜられた染料溶液を使って布を染める方法だけを教えてくれると約束しました。
local: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.
ja_pron: Soko de, Dan-san wa jizen ni mazerareta senryō yōeki o tsukatte nuno o someru hōhō dake o oshiete kureru to yakusoku shimashita.
native: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.

en: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
zh: 大理的魅力在於藍與白之間的自然對比。
ja: 大理の魅力は青と白の自然な対比にあります。
local: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
ja_pron: Dairi no miryoku wa ao to shiro no shizen na taibi ni arimasu
native: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.

en: Go back and buy it.
zh: 回去買吧。
ja: 戻って買いなさい。
local: Go back and buy it.
ja_pron: modotte kainasai
native: Go back and buy it.

en: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
zh: 大理的魅力在於藍與白之間的自然對比。
ja: 大理の魅力は青と白の自然な対比にあります。
local: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
ja_pron: Dairi no miryoku wa ao to shiro no shizen na taibi ni arimasu
native: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.

en: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety,
zh: 正是縫線的鬆緊影響了多樣性，
ja: まさに縫い目のゆるさやきつさが多様性に影響を与えます。
local: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety,
ja_pron: masani nuime no yurusa ya kitsusa ga tayousei ni eikyou o ataemasu
native: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety,

en: making every piece unique.
zh: 使每一件作品都獨一無二。
ja: それがそれぞれの作品を唯一無二にします。
local: making every piece unique.
ja_pron: sore ga sorezore no sakuhin o yuiitsu muni shimasu
native: making every piece unique.

en: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.
zh: 正是這種獨特性吸引了遊客及他們的需求。
ja: この独自性が観光客や彼らの欲求を引き寄せます。
local: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.
ja_pron: kono dokujisei ga kankoukyaku ya karera no yokkyuu o hikiyosemasu
native: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.

en: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.
zh: 古代中國人說七月和八月的雲很瘋狂。
ja: 古代の中国人は7月と8月の雲は狂っていると言いました。
local: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.
ja_pron: kodai no chuugokujin wa shichigatsu to hachigatsu no kumo wa kurutte iru to iimashita
native: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.

en: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.
zh: 在大理，立秋時節，雲彩真的讓人驚嘆。
ja: 大理では、立秋の頃の雲が本当に驚かせます。
local: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.
ja_pron: Dairi de wa, risshuu no koro no kumo ga hontou ni odorokasemasu
native: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.

en: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain
zh: 大理對中國人來說是一個烏托邦，五個村莊夾在唐山之間
ja: 大理は中国人にとってユートピアであり、5つの村が唐山の間にあります。
local: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain
ja_pron: Dairi wa Chuugokujin ni totte yuutopia de ari, itsutsu no mura ga Tousan no aida ni arimasu
native: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain

en: and R.I. Lake.
zh: 和洱海之間。
ja: そして洱海の間にあります。
local: and R.I. Lake.
ja_pron: soshite Erhai no aida ni arimasu
native: and R.I. Lake.

en: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.
zh: 輕鬆的氛圍吸引了各行各業的年輕人。
ja: リラックスした雰囲気があらゆる職業の若者を引きつけます。
local: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.
ja_pron: rirakkusu shita funiki ga arayuru shokugyou no wakamono o hikitsukemasu
native: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.

en: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.
zh: 如今，大理已從一個小村莊發展成一個不斷擴大的創意城鎮。
ja: 今日、大理は小さな村から広がりのある創造的な町へと成長しました。
local: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.
ja_pron: kyou, Dairi wa chiisana mura kara hirogari no aru souzouteki na machi e to seichou shimashita
native: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.

en: It is the most important thing to do.
zh: 這是最重要的事情。
ja: それが最も重要なことです。
local: It is the most important thing to do.
ja_pron: sore ga mottomo juuyou na koto desu
native: It is the most important thing to do.

en: It is the most important thing to do.

native: It is the most important thing to do.

en: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.
zh: 沙爾拜她的家人是大理的新守護者。
ja: シャルバイの家族は大理の新しい守護者です。
local: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.
ja_pron: Sharubai no kazoku wa Dairi no atarashii shugosha desu
native: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.

en: Is this a mirror?
zh: 這是鏡子嗎？
ja: これは鏡ですか？
local: Is this a mirror?
ja_pron: kore wa kagami desu ka
native: Is this a mirror?

en: It is a mirror.
zh: 這是一面鏡子。
ja: これは鏡です。
local: It is a mirror.
ja_pron: kore wa kagami desu
native: It is a mirror.

en: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.
zh: 沙爾拜在大理，像許多現代年輕人一樣，離開家鄉去大城市追夢。
ja: シャルバイは大理で、多くの若者と同じように夢を追いかけて大都市へ家を離れました。
local: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.
ja_pron: Sharubai wa Dairi de, ooku no wakamono to onaji you ni yume o oikakete daitoshi e ie o hanaremashita
native: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.

en: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.
zh: 但在2013年，他們選擇一起回家，為新一代製作大理的產品。
ja: しかし2013年、彼らは新しい世代のために大理のものを作るために一緒に故郷に戻ることを選びました。
local: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.
ja_pron: shikashi 2013 nen, karera wa atarashii sedai no tame ni Dairi no mono o tsukuru tame ni issho ni kokyou ni modoru koto o erabimashita
native: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.

en: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.
zh: 在這個世紀，沙爾拜回家，創造了她自己的大理產品。
ja: この世紀に、シャルバイは故郷に戻り、自分の大理のものを作り出しました。
local: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.
ja_pron: kono seiki ni, Sharubai wa kokyou ni modori, jibun no Dairi no mono o tsukurimashita
native: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.

en: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.
zh: 她的目標不僅是銷售產品，還幫助讓傳統技藝更廣為人知。
ja: 彼女の目標は製品を売るだけでなく、伝統技術がより多くの人に知られるようにすることです。
local: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.
ja_pron: kanojo no mokuhyou wa seihin o uru dake de naku, dentou gijutsu ga yori ooku no hito ni shirareru you ni suru koto desu
native: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.

en: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.
zh: 她幫助人們接觸自然，並通過大理的產品享受更慢的生活節奏。
ja: 彼女は人々が自然と触れ合い、大理のものを通じてゆったりとした生活を楽しむ手助けをしています。
local: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.
ja_pron: kanojo wa hitobito ga shizen to fureau, Dairi no mono o tsuujite yuttari to shita seikatsu o tanoshimu tedasuke o shiteimasu
native: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.

en: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.
zh: 可以說是一種嬉皮士的生活方式。
ja: いわゆるヒッピーのライフスタイルと言えるでしょう。
local: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.
ja_pron: iwayuru hippii no raifusutairu to ieru deshou
native: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.

en: The thing that is important with Daidai is that Ancient
zh: 大理重要的是古老的
ja: 大理で重要なのは古代の
local: The thing that is important with Daidai is that Ancient
ja_pron: Dairi de juuyou na no wa kodai no
native: The thing that is important with Daidai is that Ancient

en: Her creativity made blankets,
zh: 她的創造力製作了毯子，
ja: 彼女の創造力が毛布を作りました。
local: Her creativity made blankets,
ja_pron: kanojo no souzouryoku ga moufu o tsukurimashita
native: Her creativity made blankets,

en: but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.
zh: 但小白使用古老的染色方法。
ja: しかしシャオバイは古代の染色方法を使います。
local: but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.
ja_pron: shikashi Shaobai wa kodai no senshoku houhou o tsukaimasu
native: but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.

en: The dyes are all derived from plants,
zh: 染料全部來自植物，
ja: 染料はすべて植物から作られています。
local: The dyes are all derived from plants,
ja_pron: senryou wa subete shokubutsu kara tsukurareteimasu
native: The dyes are all derived from plants,

en: and this natural connection inspires people.
zh: 這種自然的聯繫激勵著人們。
ja: この自然なつながりが人々にインスピレーションを与えます。
local: and this natural connection inspires people.
ja_pron: kono shizen na tsunagari ga hitobito ni insupireeshon o ataemasu
native: and this natural connection inspires people.

en: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from a fire into her courtyard.
zh: 下午，小白從火邊迎接客人到她的院子裡。
ja: 午後、シャオバイは火のそばから客を迎え入れます。
local: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from a fire into her courtyard.
ja_pron: gogo, Shaobai wa hi no soba kara kyaku o mukae iremasu
native: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from a fire into her courtyard.

en: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dang
zh: 在父母的陪伴下，孩子們學習扎染
ja: 親に付き添われて、子供たちは絞り染めについて学びます。
local: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dang
ja_pron: oya ni tsukisowarete, kodomotachi wa shiborizome ni tsuite manabimasu
native: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dang

en: and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.
zh: 並開始關心植物，了解植物世界的美麗。
ja: そして植物に関心を持ち、植物の美しさについて学び始めます。
local: and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.
ja_pron: soshite shokubutsu ni kanshin o mochi, shokubutsu no utsukushisa ni tsuite manabi hajimemasu
native: and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.

en: Very good!
zh: 非常好！
ja: とても良い！
local: Very good!
ja_pron: totemo yoi
native: Very good!

en: No, it works, but it works!
zh: 不，它有效，但確實有效！
ja: いいえ、うまくいきます、でも本当にうまくいきます！
local: No, it works, but it works!
ja_pron: iie, umaku ikimasu, demo hontou ni umaku ikimasu
native: No, it works, but it works!

en: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.
zh: 科學佔據了整個白天的比例。
ja: 科学は一日中の全体の割合を占めています。
local: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.
ja_pron: kagaku wa ichinichijuu no zentai no wariai o shimeteimasu
native: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.

en: The work of the Dolphin was never about getting there.
zh: 海豚的工作從來不是關於到達那裡。
